coordinate_system.rule: Whole logical window in dp, before any child applies insets.
Host reports status bar/cutout, navigation/gesture bar and IME. Apply each inset exactly once.
Origin begins after the declared safe top/bottom insets; page contract declares edge-to-edge or inset-content behavior.
Components use dp geometry and sp text. Frozen raster coordinates convert through the page-specific formula and never add a second window offset.

layout_rules.fixed: Keep the component in its registered frozen slot. Fixed does not mean window-sticky unless the page authority explicitly says so.
layout_rules.flexible: Grow within declared constraints; never stretch an image or glass surface to consume spare height.
layout_rules.scrollable: Scroll dense/detail content before compressing facts, actions, or touch targets.
layout_rules.adaptive: Allow cards/rows to grow or reflow while preserving semantic order and source-specific crop policy.
layout_rules.hidden: No layout slot or hit target is exposed in the declared state; do not leave an invisible interactive target.

insets.safe_area: Status bar and display cutout are host-provided top safe insets; consume once.
insets.navigation_bar: Host-provided bottom gesture/navigation inset; primary action remains above it.
insets.keyboard: IME recalculates the usable viewport; resize/scroll focused field and primary action into view.
insets.origin: Declare one window/content origin. Do not combine safeDrawing inset with a second full-window offset.

font_scale.rule: Honor OS fontScale. Let containers grow and long screens scroll; do not silently reduce or cancel scale.

spacing_scope.shared_dp: geometry.space.* values are dp defaults for shared/new component geometry.
spacing_scope.frozen_page_reference_px: Core Visual V1 spacing values are 8,16,24,32,40,48,64,80 reference px and continue to use each page's existing conversion formula.
spacing_scope.conflict: A dp token is not a 1:1 replacement for a source-px value. Preserve Frozen page geometry.

radius_scope.shared_dp: 8,12,16,24,32dp and Circle are shared radius defaults.
radius_scope.frozen_page_reference_px: Core Visual V1 radius values are source reference px and continue to use their page conversion.
radius_scope.conflict: Do not rewrite existing page/frame radii to match the shared dp scale.

media_rules.Fill: Aspect-preserving fill. Crop overflow only if page authority allows it; otherwise use Fit.
media_rules.Fit: Aspect-preserving fit with full image visible.
media_rules.Cover: Aspect-preserving cover with crop confined to an approved safe rect.
media_rules.Contain: Show full source in the inner frame; letterbox if ratios differ.
media_rules.Evidence_Fit: Show all user evidence, no crop.
media_rules.Letterbox: Fill unused area from registered surface/background token.
media_rules.Blur_Background: Same-source, low-salience ambient behind Fit; foreground remains legible and unchanged.

conflicts.resolution: Record both units with separate scopes; Frozen page formulas remain authoritative. No asset or page geometry changed.
Keep the frozen 28dp button radius as an explicit component exception alongside the required shared radius scale.

historical_issues.rule: Approved NH05 whole-page offset min(E×0.36,180×S), E=max(0,(H−T−B)−1920S); one physical window origin; consume insets once.
historical_issues.phase2: Rule is recorded; anchor measurement remains a page contract/runtime task.

historical_issues.rule: Keep state-specific Hero and Mist Glass geometry; size to content and scroll; never stretch glass to fill spare viewport.
historical_issues.phase2: Rule frozen; page-level confirmation remains in Page Contract.

historical_issues.rule: Use approved safe Fill or same-source Safe Fit plus low-salience ambient; no arbitrary crop.
historical_issues.phase2: Rule frozen; no device run in this phase.

historical_issues.rule: Dynamic IME inset plus resize/scroll; focused input and primary action remain reachable.
historical_issues.phase2: Rule frozen; page-level confirmation remains in Page Contract.

acceptance_rules: All layout measurements cite dp tokens or a page Frozen authority with a conversion formula.
Apply status/cutout/navigation/IME insets once and record the content origin.
At 360/393/412/480dp, no image non-uniform stretch; no action is hidden by the navigation inset or IME.
At fontScale 1.0/1.15/1.3, semantic order and readability remain; containers grow or scroll.
Each media slot declares one of the registered scale modes and the crop authority.
